prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
finish, new_flow changes are helpful, delivering 5 wins (+10.8%, +7.0%, +3.6%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 8 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, delivering 5 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%, +1.7%), though 8 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in, reorder is high-risk with 1 win (+12.0%) and 2 severe losses (-7.0%, -7.4%), while adoption, redesign and sign_in, layout failed to yield any wins.
adoption, copy; adoption, layout; sign_in, hint; and home, notification consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.
Single-test kinds (such as adoption, wait_info; choose_path, hint; choose_path, layout; choose_path, reorder; and sign_in, copy) still have thin evidence and do not form established patterns.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak or failing changes while underestimating major unexpected wins.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Visibility and Controls Warmup Flow: Adds an interactive step-by-step guided practice flow on the final screen showing users how to locate, drag, hide, and summon their pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple emails about users not knowing how to control or hide their pet, and finish step new_flow changes have delivered major conversion gains (+10.8%, +7.0%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Companion Desktop Rendering Progress Status Ticker: Displays live status updates detailing desktop environment background rendering stages while waiting for pet creation. (why: Wait info changes on the home waiting screen consistently improve completion (+4.1%, +3.1%), helping bridge the 89s to 201s adoption-to-home wait times.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Live Preview Calibration Flow: Introduces a visual calibration step on photo upload that verifies asset render parameters and allows real-time adjustments before generation. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel leak (71.8% conversion) and support reported 3 emails regarding custom pets failing or looking wrong.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Tray Icon Summon and Hide Guided Flow: Guides the user through an interactive trial of using the tray icon and hotkeys to minimize and restore the pet companion. (why: Support logged multiple tickets from users confused about hiding and summoning pets post-onboarding; finish new flows are proven winners.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Desktop Launch Preparation Time Counter: Adds an active stage countdown with clear minute/second estimations on the generation waiting screen. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s); clear wait_info indicators on home have repeatedly won in historical tests.)
5: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Reconnect Pet Retrieval Flow: Adds an explicit account verification check during sign-in that scans for existing pets and previews existing profile assets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again; providing account asset recovery reassurance solves account anxiety.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Asset Generation Live Progress Tracker: Replaces static wait text on the waiting screen with a detailed live milestone checklist showing asset compiling stages. (why: Wait_info on the home step has yielded 5 historic wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, etc.) by keeping users informed during long generation waits.)

scores.note: Finish step has high base completion (92.3%), but finish, new_flow historical record shows high win rate and large upsides.
Home step has low drop-off (96.2%), but long wait time and home, wait_info pattern consistently delivers solid wins.
Adoption is the largest funnel leak (71.8%) and mail confirms asset issues, but complex new flows in adoption carry high failure risk.
Target step loss is small, but support mails align and finish, new_flow is a proven winning pattern.
Low implementation cost widget targeting long wait times on home step; home, wait_info historically yields reliable gains.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails on sign_in drop, but sign_in flow changes carry historical risk of severe losses.
Detailed live milestone tracker directly addresses long home wait times via a high-confidence change category (home, wait_info).
